title: Egyptian Tuna Skewers
description: A vegetarian-friendly Egyptian dish featuring tuna, with a jammy and glassy texture, perfect for a hangover cure. This air-fry recipe is a unique twist on traditional Egyptian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, pomegranate molasses, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tuna cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the tuna cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Cook the skewers in the air fryer for 8-10 minutes, or until the tuna is cooked through and slightly charred.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of crusty bread or over a bed of mixed greens.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 24 hours.
Reheat the skewers in the air fryer or oven until warmed through.
